title: Before Opening Up the 70B Weights, Tencent First Gave Hy4 a Safety Checkup

content_html:
On November 20, the Tencent Hunyuan team released the weights of the Hy4 large model on four platforms—GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode—where developers can download and deploy them. With this, the Hunyuan LLM series is now fully open-sourced—Hy3 preview, Hy3, Hy4 preview, Hy4, and Hy4 flash are all present, completing the family.
